'''Paul D. McNicholas''' is an Irish-Canadian statistician. He is a professor and University Scholar in the Department of Mathematics and Statistics at [[McMaster University]].<ref>{{Cite web|title=Home|url=https://ms.mcmaster.ca/~paul/|access-date=2020-07-28|website=ms.mcmaster.ca}}</ref> In 2015, McNicholas was awarded the Tier 1 Canada Research Chair in Computational Statistics.<ref name="chair">{{Cite web|date=2017 |title=Canada Research Chairs - Paul McNicholas - Canada Research Chair in Computational Statistics |url=https://www.chairs-chaires.gc.ca/chairholders-titulaires/profile-eng.aspx?profileId=3558|archive-url=|archive-date=|access-date=2020-07-28|website=chairs-chaires.gc.ca}}</ref>  McNicholas uses computational statistics techniques, and mixture models in particular, to gain insight into large and complex datasets.<ref name=":1">{{Cite web|date=2019-05-06|title=NSERC - E.W.R. Steacie Memorial Fellowships - E.W.R. Steacie Memorial Fellowship|url=http://www.nserc-crsng.gc.ca/Prizes-Prix/Steacie-Steacie/Profiles-Profils/McNicholas-McNicholas_eng.asp|access-date=2020-06-19|website=Natural Sciences and Engineering Research Council of Canada (NSERC)}}</ref> He is editor-in-chief of the [[Journal of Classification]].<ref>{{Cite web|last=|first=|date=|title=Journal of Classification|url=https://www.springer.com/journal/357/updates/18198504|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200728020418/https://www.springer.com/journal/357/updates/18198504|archive-date=28 July 2020|access-date=2020-06-21|website=Springer|url-status=dead}}</ref>

== Education and career ==
McNicholas attended [[Trinity College Dublin]] where in 2004 he received a B.A. (Mod.) in Mathematics. He also holds an M.Sc. in High Performance Computing and a Ph.D. in Statistics.<ref name=":2">{{Cite web|title=About|url=https://ms.mcmaster.ca/~paul/~paul/about.html|access-date=2020-07-28|website=ms.mcmaster.ca}}</ref> His 2007 Ph.D. thesis is entitled ''Topics in Unsupervised Learning''.<ref>{{Cite thesis|title=Topics in unsupervised learning|url=http://www.tara.tcd.ie/handle/2262/86503|publisher=Trinity College (Dublin, Ireland). School of Computer Science & Statistics|date=2007|degree=thesis|language=en|first=Paul David|last=McNicholas|hdl=2262/86503 }}</ref>

McNicholas started his faculty career at University of Guelph in 2007. In 2014, he joined McMaster University.<ref name=":2" /> He has authored more than 100 scientific works cited over 4000 times.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Paul D. McNicholas - Google Scholar Citations|url=https://scholar.google.ca/citations?user=CjquXRYAAAAJ&hl=en&oi=ao|access-date=2020-06-20|website=scholar.google.ca}}</ref> The majority of his research has been on [[model-based clustering]], specifically in developing novel finite [[Statistical classification|mixture models]] for [[Cluster analysis|clustering]] and [[Statistical classification|classification]] of [[Multivariate statistics|multivariate]] data. He has published works on clustering high-dimensional data and the use of non-Gaussian mixtures.<ref>{{Cite journal|last=McNicholas|first=Paul D.|date=2016-10-01|title=Model-Based Clustering|journal=Journal of Classification|language=en|volume=33|issue=3|pages=331–373|doi=10.1007/s00357-016-9211-9|issn=1432-1343|doi-access=free}}</ref> McNicholas has published two monographs: ''Mixture Model-Based Classification''<ref>{{Cite web|title=Mixture Model-Based Classification|url=https://www.routledge.com/Mixture-Model-Based-Classification/McNicholas/p/book/9781482225662|access-date=2020-06-20|website=CRC Press|language=en}}</ref> and ''Data Science with Julia''.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Data Science with Julia|url=https://www.routledge.com/Data-Science-with-Julia/McNicholas-Tait/p/book/9781138499980|access-date=2020-06-21|website=CRC Press|language=en}}</ref>

*2017 College Member, [[Royal Society of Canada]].<ref>{{Cite web|title=Two faculty named to the College of New Scholars, Artists and Scientists|url=https://brighterworld.mcmaster.ca/articles/two-faculty-named-to-the-college-of-new-scholars-artists-and-scientists/|access-date=2020-06-21|language=en-US}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|last=|first=|date=|title=College of New Scholars, Artists and Scientists (2017 Cohort)|url=https://rsc-src.ca/sites/default/files/College%20Citations%202017_1.pdf|archive-url=|archive-date=|access-date=|website=}}</ref>
